summary: Markets are mixed but stabilizing after an early risk-off reaction to the US midterm-election outcome: equities recovered, gold and Treasuries strengthened, while the dollar weakened.[1][7] Crypto remains fragile, with Bitcoin recovering from a seven-week low near $77,900, while broader altcoin conviction is constructive over the coming weeks but not strongly confirmed by same-day calls.[5][7]
